scoring_justification: Exact numerical match is infeasible due to different implementations; structural trends (plateau, monotonicity, temperature rise, fraction limits, curve similarity) are verifiable and consistent with the paper.

outputs.description: Compiled averaged single-crystal response for all required thermomechanical and isothermal cases. The file must contain at least the six required condition sets, each with ≥200 strain points covering the strain range [0, 0.2].

output_contract.notes: The scored artifact captures the qualitative trends in stress-strain, temperature, martensitic volume fraction, and plastic microstrain as a function of loading direction, initial temperature, and thermal boundary condition. The hidden checker validates these structural relations against paper-derived thresholds.

checks.name: case_presence_and_points
checks.desc: All six required cases present with >=200 strain points each.

checks.name: strain_coverage
checks.desc: Each case has strain values covering at least [0.0, 0.2] (min <=0.01, max >=0.19).

checks.name: iso_100_300_plateau
checks.desc: Isothermal [100] 300K shows a stress plateau and final xi_M>=0.9.

checks.name: thermo_100_300_monotonic_and_temp
checks.desc: Thermomechanical [100] 300K: monotonic stress increase, final temperature >=310K, final xi_M<0.8.

checks.name: thermo_100_350_higher
checks.desc: Thermomechanical stress > isothermal for [100] 350K after strain 0.05; plastic microstrain>0.

checks.name: iso_111_350_similar
checks.desc: [111] 350K: iso and thermo curves nearly same, xi_M<0.2 throughout, plastic microstrain>0.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for structural trend checks derived from paper descriptions (Fig 2, Fig 3).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's qualitative description of the expected behaviour for each case.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Thresholds chosen to be consistent with the physically described trends: plateau vs monotonicity, temperature rise, transformation fraction bounds.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are not numerical gold values but logical thresholds that a correct implementation must satisfy, independent of exact solver numerics.
